method: Independent derivation and numerical checks, separate from rendered text
claims: A pulse emitted at time kT has center x0+v kT and radius c(t-kT). Each center stays fixed in still air. Adjacent leading wavefronts are separated by (c-v)T and trailing fronts by (c+v)T. Stationary observers therefore receive frequency c/((c±v)T).
Scene is a 2D cross-section of sound wavefronts, not air-particle trajectories. Source speed is below sound speed. The light Doppler formula differs.
limitations: Numerical samples verify implementation consistency, not a substitute for the stated general arguments.
